---
name: Idea
about: Discuss a possible TAP before writing it (TAP-01 §5, the Idea stage)
title: "Idea: <short title>"
labels: idea
---

**Problem.** What is missing or broken today, and who runs into it?

**Proposal.** A rough outline of the solution. Links to an existing draft are welcome.

**Type.** Standards / Application / Information / Process (TAP-01 §3). If unsure, say so.

**Builds on.** Which TAPs or specifications does this depend on (for example TAP-10)?
